description: This stacked bar chart, presented with a tilted perspective, illustrates the "Token Count" across different categories labeled "Number of Shots." The horizontal category axis is labeled "Number of Shots" and includes sequentially ordered tick labels for 1, 2, 3, and 4, preceded by an initial unlabeled position. The vertical value axis is labeled "Token Count" and features a linear scale ranging from 1000 to 7000, with numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 1000, accompanied by dotted grid lines. A legend at the top indicates two components for the stacked bars: "Reasoning," represented by a salmon-orange color, and "Demonstration," represented by a blue-purple color. The first bar, located at the unlabeled initial position on the x-axis, consists entirely of the "Reasoning" component and is explicitly annotated with the value 6393 at its peak. The subsequent four bars, located at positions 1 through 4, are stacked, with the "Reasoning" component at the bottom and a smaller "Demonstration" component at the top. The total height of these stacked bars varies, with the shortest being at position 1 (approximately 4400) and the tallest of the stacked group being at position 3 (approximately 5350). A horizontal dashed line extends to the right from the top of the first bar (at the 6393 mark) across the width of the chart. Visual emphasis is provided by red, downward-pointing arrows connecting this dashed line to the top of each subsequent stacked bar. These arrows are annotated with negative values representing the difference from the dashed line: "-1952" for bar 1, "-1613" for bar 2, "-1040" for bar 3, and "-1379" for bar 4. All bars are outlined in black, and they are sorted by the sequential numerical categories on the x-axis rather than by height.
